title: Instance artifacts
note: Files and folders that cheat clients create inside the game directory the first time they run. Paths are relative to the instance root with forward slashes; folders are matched with a trailing slash. Each path was verified in the client's source code (see references).

defaults.falsePositives: Low. The folder is created by the client's own code; another mod would have to use the same folder name. A copied instance folder carries the artifact with it.
defaults.limitations: Shows that the client ran in this instance at some point (the folder survives uninstalling the client). It does not show when.

rules.name: Meteor Client data folder in instance
rules.description: The instance contains the meteor-client folder that Meteor Client creates in the game directory on start-up (MeteorClient.FOLDER).

rules.name: Wurst Client configuration in instance
rules.description: The instance contains Wurst's configuration files (wurst/enabled-hacks.json, keybinds.json …) written by WurstClient on start-up.

rules.name: LiquidBounce data folder in instance
rules.description: The instance contains the LiquidBounce folder that LiquidBounce's ConfigSystem creates in the game directory.

rules.name: BleachHack data folder in instance
rules.description: The instance contains the bleach folder that BleachHack's BleachFileMang creates in the run directory.
rules.falsePositives: Low to moderate: the folder name is short and generic. Review its contents.

rules.name: Baritone settings in instance
rules.description: The instance contains baritone/settings.txt, written by Baritone's SettingsUtil, so Baritone (stand-alone or bundled in a client) has run in this instance.
rules.falsePositives: Baritone is allowed on some servers and in singleplayer.
